sources.title: Até quanto pagar na Black Friday 2026?
sources.text: A Black Friday é uma das melhores oportunidades de compras do ano, mas nem todo desconto anunciado representa uma economia real. Para aproveitar a data, é importante saber quanto cada produto já custou e qual valor pode ser considerado uma boa oferta . Consultar o menor preço histórico antes de comprar ajuda a evitar falsas promoções e permite fazer escolhas mais inteligentes. Neste guia, o TecMundo traz algumas referências de preços para produtos populares , de celulares e notebooks a eletrodomésticos, para ajudar você a aproveitar melhor os descontos desse período. As buscas por tecnologia, celulares, televisores, eletrodomésticos e produtos para casa costumam ganhar força na Black Friday, especialmente entre consumidores que planejam compras de maior valor. Por isso, saber até que valor é vantajoso pagar no aparelho novo ajuda muito a fazer um bom negócio na hora de fechar a compra. Confira também Confira os cupons de Black Friday para resgatar já! Confira os cupons de Black Friday para resgatar já! Usamos ferramentas que monitoram buscas na internet, como Semrush e Google Trends, e agentes de inteligência artificial para montar um guia prático. A lista tem produtos com maior volume de buscas e a média de preços nos últimos 12 meses. O PlayStation 5 é um dos produtos mais desejados por quem quer aproveitar a Black Friday para investir em entretenimento. Para o PS5 Slim Digital, vale buscar ofertas próximas de R$ 2.500, enquanto a versão com leitor de discos pode ser interessante na faixa de R$ 2.800. Lembrando que o leitor também pode ser adquirido separadamente para modelos Slim. Já o PS5 Pro , que oferece desempenho gráfico aprimorado, merece atenção quando estiver em torno de R$ 5.000. Um notebook com configurações intermediárias pode atender muito bem às tarefas de trabalho, estudo, navegação e entretenimento, sem exigir um investimento elevado na Black Friday deste ano. O Dell Inspiron 15 com Intel Core i5, SSD de 512 GB, 8 GB de RAM e Windows 11 é uma opção versátil para a rotina. Se aparecer próximo a R$ 3.000 na promoção deste ano, vale a compra. O Acer Aspire 5 com i5, 512 GB SSD, 8 GB de RAM e Windows 11 é uma alternativa ao modelo da Dell e pode ser uma boa compra se for encontrado por volta de R$2.800. Televisores também estão em alta nas buscas relacionadas à maior data promocional do ano. Os modelos da Samsung e da LG são os mais almejados. A Samsung QN70H de 55 polegadas, com tecnologia Mini LED, é uma opção interessante para quem busca qualidade de imagem. Se aparecer esse modelo por algo em torno de R$ 3.400, pode crer que é uma boa oportunidade. A LG QNED70 de 55 polegadas oferece resolução 4K e recursos inteligentes, e é um bom investimento se encontrada por valores próximos de R$ 2.200 com os descontos de Black Friday. A busca por smartphones premium na Black Friday aumenta. A linha Galaxy S e o modelo mais recente do iPhone são sempre mais visados, mas é preciso saber os valores que tem sido cobrados por eles para fazer um investimento inteligente. Com opções para diferentes perfis, a linha iPhone 17 tem desde modelos mais acessíveis até versões Pro voltadas para desempenho e fotografia. Preste bastante atenção aos preços para não acabar confundindo as alternativas disponíveis. A família Galaxy S25 oferece diferentes combinações de desempenho, câmeras e recursos de inteligência artificial. Buscar ofertas realmente sabendo os preços máximos ideais ajuda bastante no processo de compra. Os tablets também são muito desejados em datas promocionais. Se você está em busca de um modelo para estudar, trabalhar ou para entretenimento, temos algumas sugestões. Mesmo sendo de duas gerações anteriores, a linha Galaxy Tab S10 segue relevante e reúne tablets para diferentes necessidades. Analise bem os recursos e especificações de cada opção para ver qual combina melhor com o seu perfil antes de fechar a compra na BF deste ano. O iPad 11” com chip A16 é uma opção para quem busca bom desempenho em produtividade, navegação e entretenimento, sendo especialmente indicado para os usuários e fãs do ecossistema Apple. Na categoria eletrodomésticos a geladeira é o mais desejado, e não é à toa. Investir em um eletro caro como este na Black Friday ajuda a reduzir bastante o investimento. Com capacidade próxima de 480 litros, a Electrolux TF7 1 é indicada para famílias que precisam de espaço e praticidade, podendo ser uma ótima aquisição com desconto na BF. A Brastemp BRM45JK combina capacidade de 375 litros e praticidade para o dia a dia. Se aparecer nessa faixa, pode representar uma boa oportunidade de investimento. Outro eletro muito desejado nesta época de calor é o ar-condicionado. Aqui, além dos valores, é importante conferir o consumo de energia e outras especificações. O Gree G-Side de 12.000 BTUs é uma alternativa interessante para quem busca boa climatização a preço justo e ainda quer economizar com os descontos da promoção. O modelo LG de 9.000 BTUs pode atender ambientes menores, sendo recomendado para quartos ou salas pequenas. Praticidade na cozinha também fica em alta na Black Friday, e o micro-ondas está entre os itens mais buscados, principalmente modelos compactos. O Electrolux ME23B conta com recursos de descongelamento e funções práticas para o uso cotidiano, sendo uma compra interessante se for encontrado na casa dos R$ 480. Se disponível por cerca de R$ 480, o modelo inox Brastemp de 20 litros com funções de pré-preparo, que podem agilizar tarefas na cozinha, é uma alternativa interessante que não pesa no bolso. Além de praticidade, a air fryer oferece uma alimentação mais saudável, por isso se tornou o eletroportátil com mais procura em datas promocionais. Se estiver nessa faixa, a Mondial Family de 4 litros é uma boa escolha para preparar porções de alimentos com praticidade em um modelo que cabe no orçamento. A WAP Barbecue Digital reúne recursos que ampliam as possibilidades de preparo de carnes suculentas em um churrasco, ainda mais se estiver nesta faixa de preç

sources.text: A Black Friday 2026 acontece oficialmente nesta sexta-feira (27), mas diversas lojas brasileiras já começaram suas campanhas promocionais, oferecendo descontos em consoles, jogos e acessórios gamer. Para quem pretende comprar um novo videogame ou melhorar seu setup, o período pode representar uma oportunidade de economizar centenas de reais. O Olhar Digital reuniu cinco ofertas de consoles e periféricos, considerando o percentual de desconto, a economia em reais e a relevância dos produtos para o público gamer. Os preços foram levantados em 26 de novembro e estão sujeitos a alterações e à disponibilidade de estoque. O Nintendo Switch OLED possui uma tela de sete polegadas, armazenamento interno de 64 GB e permite jogar tanto no modo portátil quanto conectado à televisão. O pacote inclui Super Mario Bros. Wonder, jogo de plataforma da Nintendo que apresenta novas mecânicas e possibilidades de exploração no universo do encanador. Para quem deseja experimentar jogos em realidade virtual, o PlayStation VR2 está entre os destaques da campanha oficial de Black Friday da Sony. O dispositivo conta com telas OLED, resolução 4K HDR, rastreamento ocular e recursos de feedback sensorial que ampliam a imersão durante as partidas. O controle oficial da Microsoft é compatível com os consoles Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One e computadores, sendo uma alternativa também para quem joga no PC. O acessório possui conectividade Bluetooth, botão dedicado ao compartilhamento de conteúdo e acabamento texturizado para melhorar a aderência durante as partidas. O DualSense é o controle oficial do PlayStation 5 e possui recursos como feedback háptico e gatilhos adaptáveis, que proporcionam diferentes sensações de acordo com as ações realizadas nos jogos compatíveis. A promoção contempla modelos de cores tradicionais do acessório. O Pulse Elite é um headset sem fio desenvolvido pela Sony para proporcionar uma experiência sonora imersiva. O acessório conta com drivers magnéticos planares, tecnologia PlayStation Link e microfone retrátil com redução de ruído auxiliada por inteligência artificial. Antes de finalizar uma compra, é importante verificar o histórico de preços do produto, a reputação do vendedor, as condições de garantia e os custos de frete. Também vale conferir se o desconto depende da utilização de cupons, de pagamentos via Pix ou de outras condições específicas. Os preços apresentados nesta matéria correspondem ao levantamento realizado em 25 de novembro de 2026 e podem sofrer alterações sem aviso prévio. sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: GTA 6 reinvigorates PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S/X console sales in the US, even at their inflated prices
sources.text: Despite the far higher prices of PlayStation and Xbox consoles today compared to their launch, or even the same period last year, both brands of console saw a significant boost in US sales leading up to the launch of this generation's biggest game: Grand Theft Auto 6. In the week ending 14th November, PS5 hardware unit sales registered a 2.4x increase over the same week last year. Xbox wasn't far behind, seeing a 2.3x increase in its own unit sales. That's according to industry analyst Mat Piscatella at Circana , who pulled the data from Circana's retail tracking service, which covers the US retail market. The PS5 Pro only accounted for less than 10 percent of the PlayStation's total unit sales, by the way, which Piscatella noted was "a LOT better than it has been in recent weeks", and seemingly the result of increased supply. GTA 6, of course, released on 19th November, so the surge in console hardware sales was clearly driven by the rush to attain consoles before the game came out. And while the GTA 6-driven demand isn't surprising, it's worth noting how much more expensive PS5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles are today. A standard PS5 today costs $650, compared to $550 a year ago. The PS5 Pro saw a big jump from $750 last November to $900 today. The base Xbox Series X jumped from $650 last year to $800 today, while Series S now costs $500, up from $400. Even Switch 2, where GTA 6 is not available, saw a notable boost of 40 percent in hardware sales over the same period, driven by The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake and the special edition Zelda Switch 2 console . Circana's November US video game market report, which releases in December, is already one of the most anticipated this year, for digesting and documenting the GTA 6 effect. Worldwide, GTA 6 sold more than 32.5m copies in one day , making Rockstar's parent company Take-Two $3.79bn (£2.89bn) in revenue. We haven't had any updated official sales figures since; but estimates suggest the sales figure could be well into the 40-millions. Perhaps Rockstar is waiting to hit the nice round 50m sales mark before announcing it. If you're playing GTA 6, you may want to keep Eurogamer's GTA 6 walkthrough to hand. It has plenty of very helpful guides covering the game's main missions, as well as explainers for mechanics like romance and the criminal profile , and even cheats for when you finish the game.

sources.text: A Blizzard anunciou que a Temporada do Gambito de Tyrael , de Diablo IV , chega em 1º de dezembro de 2026. A atualização tem como principal objetivo oferecer aos jogadores mais liberdade para personalizar suas experiências no endgame, etapa posterior à campanha principal. A temporada também apresenta uma série de missões protagonizadas por Tyrael, que investiga as verdadeiras intenções do culto da morte e uma nova ameaça a Santuário. A Temporada do Gambito de Tyrael introduz seis principais novidades: Além dos conteúdos inéditos, a Blizzard confirmou que recursos populares da Temporada do Legado Infernal serão incorporados permanentemente aos reinos de Temporada e Eternos. Com as mudanças, a Blizzard busca ampliar a variedade de atividades disponíveis no endgame e oferecer mais autonomia para que os jogadores desenvolvam seus personagens de acordo com seus objetivos. sources.title: How to steal an ATM and get a winched vehicle in GTA 6
sources.text: Yank out ATMs and grab the cash with Yasmani's tips. Stealing an ATM in GTA 6 requires a few different things: a winched vehicle to haul it out of the wall and drive off, plus the dye pack jammer that stops marked bills from exploding pink all over your lovely cash. There are two ways to get a winched truck. The video above shows a location at the crop duster landing strip in Frogswater where you can steal one, but you can also mod any truck at a mod shop to add a winch. If you don't have a truck to mod, there's a unique one you can steal from the Kolt & Associates June Warehouse robbery in Port Gellhorn, just south of Sarena's Bargain Store, which you could then register with Moses and mod at Wasteland Off-Road in the north of the town. You can also get a winched truck around the back of Yasmani's vape shop in Little Cuba—the fence who gives you the ATM tip offs. You'll also need the dye pack jammer, which you get in the Chapter 3 main mission, Credit Check, for Raul. Once you have both of these, you're ready to rob an ATM. If you complete all three of Yasmani's jewelry thefts (also in Chapter 3), he'll call a little later and offer tips about full ATMs, giving you three for free that you have a 24 hour window to hit. Here's how to steal them For Yasmani's tipped-off ATMs I got about 11k-ish per time, so not terrible, but likely not the best way to make money unless you get really efficient at it and invest in a proper getaway winch truck. sources.name: GamesRadar
sources.title: How to steal GTA 6 ATMs and get a winched vehicle
sources.text: You need a winched vehicle to steal a GTA 6 ATM, and you need to know how to escape with one You can start stealing GTA 6 ATMs from about midway through Chapter 3 and it'll net you some serious cash, but it's a tricky job to carry out. Technically, you can steal ATMs far earlier with a winched vehicle, but don't try it until you've picked up the dye pack jammer - it's not worth it. Since there are a few nuances to ripping ATMs out of the wall in GTA 6 , including actually getting the cash out of them, I'll explain how to steal an ATM and how to get a winch in GTA 6 below, so that you can carry out these jobs like a pro. After completing the Credit Check mission in Chapter 3, you'll have possession of a GTA 6 Dye Pack Jammer , and only then should you consider stealing ATMs out of the wall. Do it beforehand, and you'll find the cash explodes, potentially destroying your vehicle, your clothes - and the cash itself. At the right time, though, stealing ATMs can be one of the best ways to make money fast in GTA 6 . Once you've got the dye pack jammer, you can freely start nabbing ATMs with a winched vehicle, but it's only those wall-mounted to the outside of buildings. If you've also completed the Yasmani's Jewelery side quests, he'll highlight three specific locations for you where your takings will be high, but you'll only have one in-game day to grab these ones. So, whether you're doing it for Yasmani or for yourself, here's how to steal a GTA 6 ATM: To do any of this, you need a winch. To get a winch, you need to take a suitable GTA 6 car , preferably some form of pick-up truck or large off-roader, to a mod shop. You can also steal a tow truck or other vehicle that's already got a winch, but it's probably easier to just buy one than to hunt around. If you're planning on doing this often, it's probably also worth registering your favorite truck to yourself and putting a winch on that, so that you can call it up whenever you want to hit a few ATMs. If you aren't sure how to do this, take a look at our separate guide to vehicle ownership in GTA 6 . Meanwhile, if you're just struggling to legitimately use a GTA 6 ATM , Rockstar didn't make it easy, so we've got a standalone guide for that. © GamesRadar+. Not to be reproduced without permission. sources.title: How to Easily Get Gold Medals in GTA 6 Shooting Range Challenges
sources.text: Struggling to earn GTA 6 Shooting Range Gold Medals? This side activity is one of the fastest ways to level up your Focus bar and unlock unique weapon variants. On top of that, earning all 42 Gold Medals at the Shooting Range is a mandatory step on your road to the platinum trophy . Each challenge features a score or time threshold that awards a medal ranging from Bronze to Gold. Because there are plenty of tricks to rack up points more easily in every challenge, we’ve put together this guide with everything you need to know to make your runs much smoother. Below, you’ll also find images showing all Shooting Range locations in GTA 6 so you can track down every single challenge without wasting time. You can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here if you haven’t already! Below, you’ll find the locations of both Shooting Ranges currently available in GTA 6 . Keep in mind that you can use the RydeMe app to fast travel directly to each spot and save time—though with a map this good, you can always just drive there and enjoy the ride. The first thing to do when you arrive at the Shooting Range is to talk to the store attendant and buy a Waiver Pass for $5 . You’ll need this pass before you can tackle any of the challenges. You can use your own weapons, but keep in mind that some challenges require a specific weapon type , such as an SMG, Pistol, or Shotgun. If you don’t have an equipped gun in that category, you can pay $10 to rent one directly from the range . The rental guns are solid and more than capable of earning GTA 6 Shooting Range Gold Medals, so there’s no need to stress about putting together a specialized loadout. Before you start, make sure to eat or drink something to top off your Focus bar —you’ll be relying on it heavily, so it’s best to go in full. As a bonus, every challenge grants a 1% XP boost toward your Focus level, making this a great way to get both characters to Focus Level 4 . The Griffin Shooting Range challenges are noticeably harder than those at Rodgers Ranch Shooting Range because the courses require constant mobility and hitting targets on the run. Since Lucia moves faster than Jason, she’s easily the best pick for chasing Gold Medals at this range . In this course, you’ll shoot targets using a different weapon in each section. Don’t worry too much about hitting the Bullseye marks—staying agile and moving fast is far more important here. On Advanced Difficulty, save your Focus ability for the final section where you switch to the rifle. In the Hook Range challenge, you’ll start with a pistol. Shoot the targets while moving and don’t stress too much about hitting the Bullseye mark. Once you switch to the rifle, clear the regular targets and prepare for a wheel lined with red targets—activate your Focus ability here to knock them all out before they start spinning. For the final shotgun section, line up your shots to hit two targets with a single blast to save precious time. As soon as they’re down, sprint straight to the finish line! The Loop Range challenge is similar to Hook Range, except the weapon order is reversed. You’ll start with the rifle—once again, don’t stress about the Bullseye mark, and just prioritize hitting targets as fast as possible. Activate your Focus ability on the wheel if you’re having trouble landing your shots. When you switch to the pistol, stay agile and keep ignoring the Bullseye marks. The final shotgun section is the trickiest part: as soon as you clear the first wave, start reloading immediately so you’re fully loaded by the time you reach the next set of targets. It may take a couple of tries to get the hang of managing your ammo efficiently in this final stretch. The Maze Range is very similar to Loop Range—the only real twist here is that you’ll be using an Assault Rifle in the final section. Watch your ammo closely, as you only have a limited supply. As long as you save your Focus ability for this final stretch, you shouldn’t have any trouble securing the Gold Medal. Call of Duty fans will get a serious case of déjà vu during this challenge. You’ll need to move through a compound while shooting targets that resemble terrorists. Always aim for the head, as a headshot will drop them instantly and keep your momentum going. This is easily the most annoying challenge across both shooting ranges. In the Villa Range, targets will only spawn once you get close to them, so you’ll likely need to run the course a few times to memorize spawns and optimize your route. Remember to press Triangle while aiming to swap to your shotgun—it’s a much better option for clearing out the indoor targets at close range. In this course, you’ll be facing bandit targets, and the key to a Gold Medal is building your multiplier as fast as possible. To do this, shoot each bandit three times: twice in the torso, followed by a final shot to the head or pelvic region. That finishing blow must be an Instant Takedown shot, which awards 100 points at a 1x multiplier and 500 points once you hit the max 5x multiplier. If you drop bandits immediately with Instant Takedowns, it will take much longer to build your multiplier, and you’ll earn far fewer points overall. On Master Difficulty, you’ll encounter two windows where multiple bandits appear at once. Don’t bother shooting them multiple times—go straight for an Instant Takedown, as the risk of missing a target is too high during these mass spawns. A big bandit will also appear once during the run; aim to hit him four times total—three shots to the torso followed by one final blow to the head. Remember to use your Focus skill to slow down time when multiple targets appear on the screen! For this challenge, aim straight for the head on the small animals—ignore the red zone, as it’s much harder to hit consistently. When the bear appears, stick to our core tactic: land two to three shots to its torso, followed by one final blow to the red dot or head. You can use the Focus skill to slow down time and land good hits on the bear. In

sources.title: GTA 6 Bricked Up walkthrough: How to get the bonus reward in Bricked Up
sources.text: Here’s how to complete Bricked Up and get the bonus cash reward Here’s a complete walkthrough of Bricked Up from GTA 6. The Bricked Up mission in GTA 6 sees Jason and Lucia take on a job for Boobie Ike, only for a routine drug collection to turn into a dangerous police raid. This mission has a missable reward, so we’ve highlighted it in our walkthrough to make it worth your while. This is one of the final missions in Chapter 3 of GTA 6. We’re about to enter Chapter 4 in our complete GTA 6 walkthrough. Check it our in our GTA 6 walkthrough hub.Â Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. To unlock Bricked Up, complete Hidden Charges in Chapter 3. Boobie will then contact you and ask you to return to the Bayside apartment. After a conversation with Boobie, you’ll be instructed to collect a delivery owed to him by the San4San gang at Venture Apartments in Rockridge. You may remember this mission as the one from the Netflix Extended Look. Drive to Venture Apartments in Rockridge. Before entering, make sure you park outside the red marked area on your map. If you want to set up a specific getaway vehicle, you can drive it behind the apartment block into the car park. This means it’ll be accessible later in the mission. Enter the apartment building and speak to the man standing beside the elevator. Ask him for Raymond. Head upstairs, follow the corridor and knock on the red door with the small viewing slot. Unfortunately, the meeting doesn’t go according to plan. Mendez and his corrupt cops storm the apartment block, forcing Jason and Lucia into a firefight. Before leaving the first room, make sure you collect the red bag sitting near the end of the table. This contains Boobie’s drugs and is essential if you want to receive the additional $3,500 reward. You’ll initially have access to pistols, so pick up better weapons dropped by defeated officers. most of the officers are wearing body armour, so use plenty of Focus Mode to get headshots and arm shots. You can find additional adrenaline and health pickups throughout the building. Fight your way through the corridors, watching for enemies entering through side rooms. The third floor is particularly dark, making a weapon-mounted flashlight useful. You can use the stairs or elevator to progress. If the elevator gets stuck, follow the on-screen button prompt to force the doors open. Continue fighting through the building until you encounter Raymond again on the second floor. Follow his directions into the apartment on his left with the older woman sitting on the couch. At this point, Jason helps Lucia climb out through the window. You’ll then take control of Lucia. Head towards the southern parking area, find a vehicle and drive back underneath the window to collect Jason. With both characters back together, escape the police search area. Watch out for roadblocks and the police helicopter following you. Keep moving away from Venture Apartments and avoid driving back into the marked search zone. Jason can shoot the cops from the back of the car, but this can extend the chase. We reccomend you get on the motorway as quickly as possible, as cops can’t deploy as quickly there. Once you’ve lost the cops, head to the Jack of Hearts and meet Boobie outside to complete the mission. Completing Bricked Up earns you $3,500, provided you collected Boobie’s red bag during the escape. Missing the bag means losing the additional payment, so make sure you pick it up before leaving the first room.

sources.title: Sony Confirms PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December 2026
sources.text: Sony has confirmed the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December, which will be available to download from Tuesday, December 1 to Monday January 4. In a PlayStation Blog post , Sony said Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, and Amnesia: The Bunker are December’s three titles. Will you be able to tear yourself away from GTA 6 to give either of these games a shot? Or perhaps you're after a palate cleanser after pumping 100 hours into Rockstar's epic? IGN's Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 review returned an 8/10. We said: "Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 proves yet again the series’ over-the-top skateboarding formula is totally timeless, even if some of the changes to THPS4 miss the mark and the soundtrack has been fumbled." Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, meanwhile, got a 7.5 back in 2017 . "Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 is an ambitious , if rough-edged experience, with deceptively deep RPG and brawling elements," we said at the time. And our Amnesia: The Bunker review returned an 8. We said: "Amnesia: The Bunker is a smaller, more self-contained episode in the groundbreaking horror franchise that shows Frictional still has some chilling new tricks up their sleeves." It’s worth noting that PlayStation Plus members have until Monday, November 30 to add the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for November (Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered, Monster Train 2) to their library. sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. sources.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Is Out, and There Are Already Black Friday GTA 6 Deals
sources.text: Rockstar's GTA 6 has barely been out for a few days, but UK retailer ShopTo is already offering some surprisingly generous discounts on the new release across PS5 and Xbox Series X|S — letting you pay as little as £53.85 for the game. Here's how to save on what's arguably the biggest game of all time. Despite Black Friday still being a week away, the store has slashed £16.14 off the standard Xbox version of Grand Theft Auto VI, bringing its usual £69.99 price down to £53.85 at ShopTo . That's 23% off for a direct digital code, with instant delivery, and no additional vouchers or memberships needed. Better still, there are a few other ways to save on Rockstar's latest blockbuster, depending on whether you're playing on Xbox or PS5, or fancy getting some bonus content with your purchase via the Ultimate Edition As for PS5 players, ShopTo's cheapest route is a little different, since getting digital game keys for PlayStation games outside of boxed codes and PlayStation itself is a lot trickier compared to Xbox titles. Instead of receiving GTA 6 itself, ShopTo can sell you a £70 PlayStation Store gift card for only £60.85 , which you can then redeem on your UK PSN account to buy the £69.99 Standard Edition — effectively earning you £9.15 in savings. On the other hand, for anyone who wants the closest thing to a physical version of GTA 6, both consoles have a £61.85 boxed option with an added A3 double-sided poster ; that also makes ShopTo the cheapest UK retailer to buy the boxed version of Grand Theft Auto VI from right now. Remember, though, these aren't actual disc versions of GTA 6; you'll find a download code inside the packaging instead. Also, for Xbox fans who were considering buying the Grand Theft Auto 6’s Ultimate Edition anyway, ShopTo also has said Ultimate Edition on Xbox for only £67.85 — an incredibly impressive £22.14 price drop and the lowest price we’ve seen for it yet. With the Ultimate Edition, compared to the Standard Edition of GTA VI, you’ll get extra vehicles, weapons, outfits, customisation features, and exclusive locations throughout Leonida. To get that aforementioned Ultimate Edition on PS5, however, you can also grab the £100 PlayStation Store Gift Card for only £85.85 to redeem the complete version of GTA 6 for £89.99. Sure, you’ll only save £41.14 instead of buying the game through the PS Store directly, but you’ll have an extra £10 credit to spend on other games and DLC on top. Otherwise, if you’re unsure about getting the Ultimate Edition on PlayStation 5 right away, you can always buy the £20 Ultimate Edition Upgrade directly from the PlayStation Store . The same goes for the bonus Grand Theft Auto VI Vintage Vice City Pack for £4.49 — featuring the stunning ’55 Vapid Stanier sedan and garage alongside Ocean Beach, alternative outfits and hairstyles for both Jason and Lucia, and an exclusive Tropical Weapon Pattern inspired by Tommy Vercetti's iconic palm-tree shirt. At the time of writing, there is no physical disc version of GTA 6, along with there being no indication by Rockstar Games as to whether it will be putting out a disc'd edition of the game; with that, these deals are some of the best value you can get on the Grand Theft Auto sequel in the meantime. sources.title: CD Projekt Red signs new marketing partnership deal with Sony for The Witcher 4, and to increase "the presence" of its games on PlayStation
sources.text: As part of The Witcher and Cyberpunk studio CD Projekt Red's recent Q3 earnings report, the developer offered some updates on upcoming game The Witcher 4 . During an earnings call yesterday, the studio revealed it had signed a new partnership deal with Sony regarding marketing rights to The Witcher 4, as well as to extend "the presence" of CD Projekt Red's other games across the PlayStation Store and PlayStation Plus. "Just today, we signed new partnership agreements with Sony Interactive Entertainment covering the presence of our games on PlayStation and in PlayStation Plus subscriptions, as well as our collaboration during the upcoming Witcher 4 marketing campaign," said studio CFO Piotr Nielubowicz . "This cooperation will support our business and financial outlook in this and future years." Nielubowicz didn't elaborate on what exactly that means for The Witcher 4's marketing, but perhaps it could enable Sony to advertise the action-RPG as a PlayStation game, similar to the Grand Theft Auto 6 'plays best on PlayStation' campaign . But seeing as The Witcher 4 is currently targeting a 2028 release , we may not find out what form that agreement takes for some time. That said, looking at similar marketing agreements from Sony's recent history, we can probably expect The Witcher 4 to show up during Sony State of Play presentations or even have dedicated PlayStation-focused showcases. The Witcher 4 footage may also be specified as being captured on PlayStation hardware - something we already saw with The Witcher 4 tech demo last year . Perhaps we'll see Witcher-themed accessories and PlayStation hardware, too. This is a notable shift for CDPR, which has historically had close ties to Xbox. Cyberpunk 2077's big Keanu Reeves reveal (as Johnny Silverhand) took place on Xbox's E3 2019 stage , and The Witcher 3 's reveal happened on Microsoft's E3 2013 stage. Going further back, Xbox 360 was the only console The Witcher 2 was released on. During the same earnings call, CDPR joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski said that we should expect the leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4 to be similar to that between GTA 5 and GTA 6 , while also praising Rockstar's approach to marketing its record-breaking new game.
